scope.description: Complete path-level inventory after PR #886 and before the governed Ponto release candidate is selected.

coverage_through_integrated_controls.contract: The 109 path-level entries below inventory the complete pre-control interval. The deterministic PR #921 supplement inventories every later path: the eight named ledger/runbook paths are project_ledgers_and_runbook, the five named local paths are local_operator_safety, and every other PR #921 path is governed_ponto_release_controls. The two inventories overlap on 15 paths and their union covers all 179 net paths after PR #886 through the merged controls.

pending_local_corrective_overlay.contract: This overlay is evolving and is deliberately excluded from the immutable integrated-main interval above. It must not be described as frozen, exhaustive, integrated, reviewed, hosted-validated or selected for release until the final source freeze, immutable commit and merged PR are observed.
corrective_controls: trusted main workflow checkout and exact SHA verification before capability consumption
independent production-baseline and production-slo leases
all seven production baseline provenance outputs
CRM Pages physical-target serialization with per-orchestrator child isolation
first-attempt-only enforcement for the canonical coordinator and every privileged child workflow
exact active coordinator revalidation immediately before every secret-bearing or mutating job
bodyless HTTP 202 and 204 handling in dispatch, emergency-stop and child-reconciliation helpers
ponto-release-custody serialization for the three scheduled CRM Pages secret writers
removal of scheduled Escala and Meta Ads Report dispatches to the retired CRM Pages publisher
immediate target-scoped Timekeeping kill switch with persistent latch, capability invalidation, cancellation/reconciliation and final fail-close reassertion
separate emergency overlay where missing unreadable malformed or true denies
governed immutable-evidence latch reset as the sole false writer that remains in maintenance
global ponto-surface-mutation mutex and terminal coordinator watchdog with external close-only broker custody
schema-v6 target-bound Ed25519 release capabilities with environment-private signing and repository-public verification
consumer and watchdog verification with public material only
live preflight for main-only custom branch policy, no administrator bypass, exactly one prevent-self-review rule and an independent reviewer
serialized emergency-latch writers with cancel-in-progress disabled
Worker and Pages rollback gated by exact live regular-control and emergency-latch attestation before mutation and by post-mutation reread
Pages rollback dedicated target-environment intent key, exact ownership and deterministic restore
normalized exact emergencyLatchRef recovery evidence
WAF drift detection after functional probe
watchdog journal correlation and broker-backed manual kill switch
atomic external release-probe nonce consumption by one D1 UNIQUE insert before Identity login, with v2 pilot/canary run provenance and v1 staging-only
mandatory Identity release-probe session teardown with current-session revoke or logout and canonical stale-cookie 401 proof
policy-bound emergency broker identity with exact URL custody reference response key ID and Ed25519 SPKI plus HMAC request and signed response
static architecture/topology and CI coverage for every corrective invariant
pending_local_corrective_overlay.remaining_external_boundary: Historical privileged runs created before correlation and first-attempt guards cannot be retroactively changed by edited workflow definitions. Checkpointed dispatch fences and disabled legacy smokes contain known paths, but they are not independent automatic freeze/recovery. Both maintenance states remain mandatory until the evolving local controls receive a final freeze, immutable commit, hosted validation, valid review, merge, broker endpoint/key provisioning, a clinic runner and external recovery proof.

external_replay_containment.rollback_boundary: Do not restore the removed, disabled or fenced production or staging dispatch inputs until the permanent legacy-run control is integrated and the governed release prerequisites are authorized.

classification_contract.primary_classification: Exactly one disjoint primary classification is assigned to every changed path.
classification_contract.labels: Zero or more non-disjoint technical or operational facets.
classification_contract.related_prs: Pull requests identifiable from first-parent history for this range; an empty array means no PR was inferred.

ponto_impact.direct: Ponto-specific executable source, configuration, workflow, or test.
ponto_impact.shared_control: Shared source or governance changed in a way that must be included in Ponto candidate qualification.
ponto_impact.documentary: Persistent project state records Ponto status or blockers but does not itself change runtime behavior.
ponto_impact.indirect: A shared CRM surface changed for another objective and may require regression coverage for Ponto.
ponto_impact.local_only: The change belongs to CRM Local/operator tooling and is not evidence of a production Ponto change.
ponto_impact.none: No Ponto-specific or shared-runtime effect was identified from the path and its commits.
